description: This file defines interfaces related to system information and subsystem management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes interface definitions for metadata, subsystem status, security, internet, location, identification, time, provisioning, and decryption, along with associated enums and nested notification interfaces.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing access to system metadata such as build hash and version numbers.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Interface providing access to various system subsystems and their statuses, including security, network, location, and others, with notification capabilities.

classes.name: ISubSystem::INotification
classes.description: Interface for notifications about subsystem updates.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security subsystem information, such as callsign.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IInternet
classes.description: Interface for internet subsystem information, including IP address and network type.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ILocation
classes.description: Interface for location subsystem information, including timezone, country, region, and city.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IIdentifier
classes.description: Interface for device identification details such as architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IProvisioning
classes.description: Interface for provisioning information, inherits from RPC::IStringIterator.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IDecryption
classes.description: Interface for decryption information, inherits from RPC::IStringIterator.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree of the system.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for subsystem updates.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets information for a specific subsystem type.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific subsystem type.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a specific subsystem is active.
